jupas.shortDescription: an class="before_label">Short Description The Diplomacy and International Studies programme is an interdisciplinary programme jointly offered by the Faculty of Social Science and the Faculty of Law, leading to a Bachelor’s degree in Social Science. In response to the expeditious developments in geopolitics and international diplomacy, the programme is designed to cultivate high-level talents equipped with a global perspective, an international mindset, strong intercultural competence, and the ability to excel in international organizations and diplomatic settings. Emphasizing the integration of theory and practice, the Programme offers a multidisciplinary curriculum covering diplomacy, international governance, law, regional studies, and interpersonal and intercultural competence. In addition, students will gain practical experience through internships at embassies, consulates, and international organizations, along with professional training at the China Foreign Affairs University. Students will also participate in overseas exchange, ensuring exposure to learning experiences in both China and international locales.

cuhkAdmission.introduction: Jointly offered by the Faculty of Social Science and the Faculty of Law, the Diplomacy and International Studies Programme is an interdisciplinary programme leading to a Bachelor’s degree in Social Science. In response to the expeditious developments in geopolitics and international diplomacy, the Programme aims to nurture high-calibre talent equipped with a global perspective, an international mindset, strong intercultural competence, and the ability to excel in international organizations and diplomatic settings. Through cross-faculty collaboration, students will receive a comprehensive education in diplomacy, international governance, law, regional studies, and interpersonal and intercultural competence. This collaborative model also ensures that students gain a well-rounded understanding of international affairs and diplomatic practices from multiple perspectives.
cuhkAdmission.careerProspects: Graduates of this programme are expected to become diplomatic talents well-versed in international affairs while simultaneously carrying a focused understanding of China. The Programme prepares graduates for careers in both political and public diplomacy, while also opening doors to a wide range of sectors including: Government Organizations International Organizations Multinational Corporations Policy Think Tanks Consulting Firms Local and International NGOs Cultural and International Exchange Organizations Teaching and Research in Universities Mass Communication/ Public Relations Postgraduate studies If you are interested in this programme, please review the application requirements and deadlines specific to the respective admission scheme to increase your chances of getting accepted. APPLY NOW

admission.title: Admission
content: - Two elective subjects at Level 3 (may include M1/M2 or an approved language subject)
Note: For Liberal Studies taken in 2023 or before, Level 2 is considered as Attained in CSD. The LS level is not counted in score calculation.

curriculum.title: Curriculum
content: The Diplomacy and International Studies programme is an interdisciplinary programme jointly offered by the Faculty of Social Science and the Faculty of Law, leading to a Bachelor’s degree in Social Science.

The curriculum covers diplomacy, international governance, law, regional studies, and interpersonal and intercultural competence. Students gain practical experience through internships at embassies, consulates, and international organizations, along with professional training at the China Foreign Affairs University. Overseas exchange is also a key component.
For full details, visit the programme website: https://socsc.cuhk.edu.hk/diplomacy-and-international-studies/

campus.title: Campus Life
content: CUHK’s Shatin campus offers a vibrant college system with nine colleges, each providing residential, pastoral, and cultural experiences.
Students in this programme benefit from cross-faculty collaboration and have access to state-of-the-art facilities, libraries, and global learning opportunities.
Overseas exchange and internships at embassies and international organizations are integral to the programme, providing real-world diplomatic exposure.

competitiveness.title: Competitiveness
content: Band A applications and offers for 2025 are not publicly available. Based on the small intake, competition is expected to be high.
Interview is required for selected applicants.

alumni.title: Alumni & Faculty Excellence
content: The programme is housed within the Department of Government and Public Administration, which has produced numerous senior civil servants and political figures in Hong Kong.
- Wong Yuk-kuen (王玉娟): Former Permanent Secretary for Home Affairs of Hong Kong.
- Lau Siu-kai (劉兆佳): Renowned political scientist, former Head of the Central Policy Unit, professor emeritus at CUHK.
- Chow Pak-chin (周柏臻): Former Deputy Secretary for Constitutional and Mainland Affairs.
- Lam Woon-kwong (林煥光): Former Secretary for Home Affairs and Chairperson of the Equal Opportunities Commission.
- Michael Tien Puk-sun (田北辰): Legislative Council member and businessman.
Faculty members include experts in international relations, diplomacy, and comparative politics, with strong ties to policy-making bodies.

tips.title: Ace Sir's Diplomacy & International Studies Strategy — 9 Actionable Tips
content: - Median 24, LQ/UQ 26. A score of 24 gives a realistic chance; 26+ is competitive.
- Focus on Chinese, English, and two electives at Level 4 or above.
- With only 15 places, Band A is essential. Place JS4898 as your first choice if this is your top programme.
- Use Band B only if you have a very strong profile (e.g., 26+).
- Both languages are weighted heavily. Aim for Level 4 or above in English and Chinese.
- For English, practice academic writing and current affairs discussions.
- Choose electives that demonstrate analytical and global awareness: History, Economics, Geography, or a second language.
- Level 4 or above in two electives is typical for successful applicants.
- Interview is required. Expect questions on current international affairs, your motivation, and your understanding of diplomacy.
- Practice articulating your views on China’s role in global governance.
- Read international news daily (e.g., BBC, SCMP, The Economist).
- Join Model United Nations or debate clubs to sharpen your diplomatic skills.
- Use the college system for networking and mentorship.
- Attend seminars by visiting diplomats and scholars.
- The programme includes internships at embassies and consulates. Start building a CV with relevant volunteer or part-time experience.
- Consider summer programmes at China Foreign Affairs University.
- Many graduates pursue Master’s in International Relations, Law, or Public Policy.
- Research programmes at top universities (e.g., LSE, Sciences Po, Harvard) and plan your electives accordingly.

admission.title: 入學要求
content: 中位數錄取者科目成績（M行）：
- 兩門選修科目第3級（可包括M1/M2或認可語言科目）
註：2023年或之前應考通識教育科，第2級視為公民科達標，通識科成績不計入入學分數。

curriculum.title: 課程結構
content: 外交與國際事務課程由社會科學院及法律學院合辦，畢業生將獲頒社會科學學士學位。
課程涵蓋外交、國際治理、法律、區域研究及人際與跨文化能力。學生將透過在大使館、領事館及國際組織的實習，以及在外交學院的專業培訓，獲得實踐經驗。海外交流亦是課程的重要組成部分。

career.title: 就業前景
content: 畢業生將成為熟悉國際事務並深入了解中國的外交人才。就業方向包括：
- 本地及國際非政府組織

campus.title: 校園生活
content: 香港中文大學的沙田校園設有九所書院，提供住宿、文化及全人發展體驗。
本課程學生可受惠於跨學院協作，並使用先進設施、圖書館及全球學習機會。
海外交流及大使館、國際組織實習是課程的重要部分，讓學生獲得真實的外交經驗。

competitiveness.title: 競爭情況
content: 2025年Band A申請人數及取錄人數未有公開數據。由於學額有限，競爭預料激烈。

alumni.title: 校友及學系成就
content: 本課程隸屬於政治與行政學系，該學系培養了眾多香港高級公務員及政治人物。
- 王玉娟：前香港特別行政區政府民政事務局常任秘書長
- 劉兆佳：著名政治學家、前中央政策組首席顧問、中大榮休教授
- 周柏臻：前政制及內地事務局副局長
- 林煥光：前民政事務局局長、平等機會委員會主席
- 田北辰：立法會議員、企業家
學系教授包括國際關係、外交及比較政治專家，與政策制定機構聯繫緊密。

scholarships.title: 獎學金及資助
content: 香港中文大學為本地及非本地學生提供多項基於學術成績的獎學金，包括JUPAS入學獎學金。
- 其他主要獎學金（如滙豐、尤德爵士紀念基金）
- 資助：TSFS（專上學生資助計劃）及NLSPS（免入息審查貸款計劃）

tips.title: Ace Sir的外交與國際事務策略 — 9個實用貼士
content: - 中位數24，下/上四分位數26。24分有機會，26分以上更具競爭力。
- 重點提升中文、英文及兩門選修科至第4級或以上。
- 學額僅15個，必須將JS4898放在Band A首位。
- 除非分數達26分以上，否則不建議放在Band B。
- 兩科均佔較重比重，目標第4級或以上。
- 英文需加強學術寫作及時事討論能力。
- 選擇能展示分析及全球視野的科目：歷史、經濟、地理或第二語言。
- 成功申請者通常有兩科選修達第4級或以上。
- 面試為必須環節，問題圍繞國際時事、申請動機及對外交的理解。
- 練習表達對中國在全球治理角色的看法。
- 每日閱讀國際新聞（如BBC、南華早報、經濟學人）。
- 參加模擬聯合國或辯論隊，鍛煉外交技巧。
- 利用書院系統建立人脈及尋求指導。
- 參加由訪問外交官及學者主講的講座。
- 課程包括大使館及領事館實習，盡早建立相關履歷（義工或兼職經驗）。
- 考慮參加外交學院的暑期課程。
- 許多畢業生攻讀國際關係、法律或公共政策碩士。
- 研究頂尖大學（如LSE、巴黎政治學院、哈佛）的課程，並相應規劃選修科。
